column1: # Lexeme class `verb_motion_directed`: verbs of motion that combine with a direction or goal
# (nach Berlin, ins Wasser, über die Straße). With a direction they take `sein` in the perfect
# (ich bin nach Berlin gefahren); the lexicon's `perf=` says whether `haben` is possible too.
# Values: self (the subject moves by itself: gehen, laufen), vehicle (by a vehicle or animal:
#   fahren, fliegen, reiten, rudern), water (in water: schwimmen, tauchen),
#   fall (uncontrolled downward motion: fallen, stürzen, sinken), flow (fließen, treiben, rollen, gleiten).
# Written from own knowledge of German (clean-room); only lemmas of this lexicon.
